Sealing wax
nodes.rationale: Valmiel notaries' sealing wax (fictional text, 1399): beeswax mixed with pine resin and cinnabar in a ratio of 5 parts wax to 2 parts resin to 1 part cinnabar.
nodes.evidence: dans la proportion de 5 parts de cire pour 2 de résine et 1 de cinabre

nodes.label: Notaries of Valmiel
nodes.rationale: Fictional notaries (1399) who seal acts with wax mixed with pine resin and cinnabar, and buy their wax only from the sworn wax-chandler, never at the market.
nodes.evidence: Les notaires achètent leur cire au cirier juré, jamais au marché.

nodes.label: Pine resin
nodes.rationale: Ingredient of the Valmiel sealing wax: 2 parts per 5 parts of wax.
nodes.evidence: une cire mêlée de résine de pin et de cinabre

nodes.label: Cinnabar

nodes.evidence: 5 parts de cire pour 2 de résine et 1 de cinabre

nodes.label: Sworn wax-chandler
nodes.rationale: The cirier juré is the only permitted supplier of wax to the Valmiel notaries; buying at the market is excluded.
nodes.evidence: Les notaires achètent leur cire au cirier juré, jamais au marché.

nodes.label: Seal integrity rule
nodes.rationale: A seal that cracks within the year makes the notarial act suspect, which explains the strict wax recipe and controlled supply.
nodes.evidence: Un sceau qui se fend dans l'année rend l'acte suspect.
